objective: Reject invalid CPVS magnitude-error values and correct the source-identity join by using the documented Table2 Seq/SourceID field; preserve fail-closed scientific validation.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Source-backed Scientific Validation run 39583481592 completed acquisition and retained the heavy evidence artifact (artifact SHA256 debd55db39be64c5e267af44bc1e486824b3d6d0c0caeac9f04fca254c05410c).
Historical derivation reported 741787 candidates versus 741785 in independent row-wise diagnostics under the prior implementation.
VizieR's original CPVS Table2 schema identifies ID as the ZTF name and Seq as the internal source identifier; Zenodo record 3886372 states SourceID joins the ztf2g/ztf2r attachments to Table2.
VizieR Table4's ID is a catalog-internal identifier, not a guaranteed Table2 Seq. Numeric ID-only comparison is not object-level proof.

A first object-name crosswalk that mapped parent row ordinals produced 16686 candidate-only and 5083 published-only; those counts are invalid diagnostics because the implementation ignored the documented Seq field.

baseline.description: Scientific gate remains unresolved. A confirmed invalid-SNR guard defect and a confirmed Table2 identity-mapping defect are being corrected; full re-derivation and object-level membership validation remain pending.

expected_improvement: Reject non-finite SNR values explicitly instead of allowing NaN to pass a threshold comparison.
Use the explicit Table2 Seq/internal SourceID value rather than row ordinal for parent and photometry joins.
Reject missing, malformed, or duplicate Seq values; preserve full discrepant SourceID/ZTF-name lists and input hashes.
Keep exact-membership acceptance fail-closed; do not change thresholds to force count equality.

correctness.before: Invalid SNR can pass the threshold guard when the computed SNR is NaN; derivation reported 741787 candidates versus 741785 in independent row-wise diagnostics.
correctness.after: Non-finite SNR is explicitly rejected; Table2 Seq parsing and regression tests have been added. Latest CI and full source-backed re-derivation are pending.

scientific_validity.before: Historical numeric-ID comparison: 741787 candidates; 730184 published objects; 730182 intersection; 11605 candidate-only; 2 published-only. A later row-ordinal crosswalk reported 16686 candidate-only and 5083 published-only, but that crosswalk used the wrong identity mapping and is not valid evidence.
scientific_validity.after: Explicit Seq-based parent mapping is implemented; the corrected full re-derivation/crosswalk has not completed. No corrected membership counts or residual root cause are claimed.
scientific_validity.evidence: Zenodo record 3886372; VizieR J/ApJS/249/18 Table2 schema; VizieR J/ApJ/932/118 ReadMe; PR #206; retained artifact from run 39583481592.

evidence: Added explicit math.isfinite(snr) check before threshold comparison.
Added regression tests for blank/NaN magnitude errors.
Corrected CPVS Table2 identity mapping to read explicit Seq/SourceID; row order is no longer accepted as a substitute.
Added tests for non-contiguous Seq values, missing/duplicate Seq, ZIP input, and ZTF-name crosswalk independent of Table4 internal IDs.
Corrected selection diagnostics to compare published ZTF names mapped into Table2 Seq IDs.
Corrected full source-backed re-derivation and audit are pending; no scientific resolution is claimed.

root_causes: Confirmed implementation defect: _snr_from_mag_error returns NaN for invalid errors, while the previous guard only checked snr < sigma; NaN comparisons are false, so invalid-error rows could qualify.

Confirmed identifier-mapping defect: CPVS Table2's second field is Seq/internal SourceID, but the prior derivation and first crosswalk used one-based row ordinal. The resulting 16686/5083 crosswalk counts are invalid and must not be interpreted as true membership discrepancies.
Residual selection/membership discrepancy after explicit Seq mapping is not yet measured; selection semantics and every remaining discrepant object must be traced before sign-off.
Table4's internal ID values 781603/781604 cannot be compared directly to the parent row count as if they were Table2 Seq IDs; map by ZTF object name into the explicit Seq namespace.

findings: Non-finite numeric results must be rejected explicitly before threshold comparisons.
CPVS Table2 Seq is the documented internal identifier joining the catalog to single-exposure photometry; row order is not a safe join key.
VizieR Table4's catalog-internal ID must not be assumed equal to Table2 Seq; use ZTF-name crosswalks.
Fixing identifier semantics and the invalid-SNR guard does not establish exact CPVS membership until full source-backed validation passes.
Do not change SNR thresholds or acceptance criteria merely to force count equality.
